summary: Sony Group filed a Form 6-K reporting the October 2026 status of its ongoing open-market buyback, a Japan-style program disclosed via foreign private issuer report. Under the May 8, 2026 board authorization (up to 230 million shares, 3.89% of outstanding excluding treasury, capped at ¥500 billion, running May 11, 2026 to May 10, 2027), Sony repurchased 11,592,100 shares for ¥45,604,126,353 during October 1-31, 2026 via TSE discretionary trading. Cumulative repurchases reach 86,065,800 shares for ¥308,962,118,545 as of October 31, 2026, leaving roughly ¥191 billion of authorization unused. Watch cadence of remaining purchases and any acceleration versus the ¥500 billion cap.
